title: Targeted ortholog search in unannotated genome assemblies with fDOG-Assembly.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Queried the Zenodo API for record 17250793: it holds one file, BIONF/fDOG-v1.2.3.zip (166,117 bytes), a GPL-3.0 code snapshot of the fDOG software, not a data table. Europe PMC supplementary file listing timed out (not retrievable).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Benchmark design (10 metazoan genome assemblies from the QfO (Quest for Orthologs) 2022 set, 5000 human seed genes searched in rat and Nematostella, 176 soil invertebrate assemblies screened for beta-lactam genes); any result tables would be in NAR supplementary files I could not list.

a1_downloadable.note: The only deposited 'data' is a 166 KB software zip on Zenodo; no released results table was found. The supplement couldn't be retrieved, and inputs are public genome assemblies, not a curated dataset.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No labelled table exists; any label (ortholog present/absent per gene per species) would have to be constructed by running ortholog-search tools on assemblies.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs are referenced by GenBank assembly accessions (e.g. GCA_000002985.3), i.e. multi-GB genomes to download and process.

a4_units_stated.note: No measurement table to have units; not checked further.

a5_enough_rows.note: No table seen; row count unknown.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: unknown; 176 invertebrate genome assemblies likely tens of GB
a6_fits_laptop.note: Estimated from paper description, not checked.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Nothing to count against the paper.

a8_label_provenance.note: Ortholog calls are outputs of computational tools (fDA, BUSCO, Compleasm, QfO methods), not physical measurements; learning them would distil those tools.

honest_claim_h3: No ML claim is possible: the paper releases a software tool, not a labelled dataset, and its outputs are computational predictions.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use protein sequences and genome assemblies to predict whether a gene's ortholog (its counterpart in another species) is present.
plain_idea.train_on: Seed protein plus target genome per example; number of examples unknown because no results table was released.
plain_idea.predict: Ortholog present or absent; the 'true' answer would itself come from ortholog-search software, not from a lab measurement.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Could help gene-content studies in unannotated genomes, but the labels are tool outputs, so a model would only copy existing tools.

ml_idea: Considered: learn ortholog presence from sequence features using fDA results as labels; rejected because no results table is deposited and the labels are computational predictions.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; project rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Zenodo record listing (done): only a 166 KB code zip.

verdict_reason: Software-tool paper: Zenodo holds only a code zip, there is no labelled table, and any ortholog labels would be tool predictions (A1, A2 and A8 fail).
